messages:
alex: Heads up — eu-west1 embedding API returning 503s since 09:12. Seen across multiple short-sequence requests. Looks like a kvcache eviction pattern. Can we fast-track a hotfix? @morgan @zara

deploybot: Artifact built: "embed-service:v1.2.3-hotfix-kv-toggle". To deploy: `/deploy embed-service --image embed-service:v1.2.3-hotfix-kv-toggle --region eu-west1`

morgan: Oncall here. I can run a quick staging promote. If this is the kvcache flag, a toggle should be low-risk. Need two approvers to skip canary per policy.

zara: I tested the image in staging (kv_stable=false -> true). Staging smoke looks clean: no 503s for short seq tests. Small config change only, no schema or model swap. Blast radius limited to eu-west1.

jamie: I'm available to approve. Quick QA: include rollback steps and a 2-min post-deploy smoke. Also add a short release note. :thumbsup:

alex: Release note draft: "Fix: Prevent kvcache eviction under short-sequence loads that caused intermittent 503s at the EU edge. Backported config toggle to v1.2.3."

Rollback plan:
- If >1% 503s or P95 latency regresses by >50% in 2m, execute:
  `/deploy rollback embed-service --image embed-service:v1.2.2 --region eu-west1`

morgan: Approving for ops. +1. Suggest canary=0 for speed (eu-only pin). Will monitor metrics and be ready to rollback.

jamie: Approve from SRE lead. +1. I authorize skipping canary given the low-risk toggle.

deploybot: Action: starting deploy to eu-west1 (skip canary). Deploy ID: `deploy-3337-eu`. Estimated rollout time: ~3m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1% over 2m.

releasebot: Release notes updated for embed-service v1.2.3-hotfix-kv-toggle (internal changelog ID: 2026-03-23-EMB-77).

alex: Smoke check commands for monitoring:
```
# simple healthcheck
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $MONITOR_TOKEN" https://eu-west1.embed.redwood/api/health
# sample short-seq test
python tests/smoke_short_seq.py --host https://eu-west1.embed.redwood
```

morgan: Watching grafana dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/eu-west1-latency (refreshing). If I see >1% 503s spike I will trigger rollback and post here.

deploybot: Rollout progress: 100% of eu-west1 updated. Post-deploy checks: 0 errors, p95 latency stable. Smoke tests passed.

jamie: Verified metrics look good. No regressions observed.

alex: Thanks all — closing thread. Will file a follow-up postmortem if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
